description.text: A quiet end-of-day shop interior, built as a fresh scene.

stands behind a worn wooden counter, one hand resting flat on the pale, scratched countertop. He is seen in a medium view with the counter edge crossing the lower foreground; behind him, shelves of plain goods and a shaded back wall fall softly out of focus. Late-afternoon light comes from a side window, laying a low warm band across the wood, catching the counter's chipped front edge and leaving the corners in cool shadow. Dust motes drift in the warm band of light. The camera holds a static shot. He lifts his gaze from the counter to the person across from him. His posture stays still while his jaw and mouth move in a plain, close-mic vocal performance; the delivery is even and unhurried, with no sharp gesture or change in stance. His shoulders are relaxed, and a simple dark work shirt shows a crease at the elbow. The room stays quiet around him, with only faint ventilation hum and a soft wood creak under the counter. No lettering appears on screen.

The fabric at his shoulder creases slightly as he settles. He remains silent, holding a closed-mouth pause after the line, with only the faint room tone and the soft creak of the shop around him. His hand stays flat on the counter edge just inside the lower frame.
